tasks.title: Persist session liveness fields
tasks.description: Add persisted liveness state to coder session records so session calls can store last data time, probe timing, and failure reason independently of issue state. This includes the SQLite migration, repository types, row mapping, insert defaults, and focused helper methods for data/probe/failure updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Database migration adds nullable last_data_at, probe_sent_at, probe_deadline_at, and failure_reason columns to coder_session without changing issues schema
New coder_session rows initialize status as running and lastDataAt to a non-null session start timestamp
CoderSessionRepo can update lastDataAt, mark probing with probe timestamps, mark failed with failureReason, and read those fields back
Existing coder_session list/detail repository methods remain compatible with existing rows that have null liveness fields
Repository or migration tests verify the new columns and helper behavior
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not add IssueSessionSummary or write session state into issues.stage/status. Treat probing as a non-terminal coder_session status.

tasks.title: Emit persisted session liveness updates
tasks.description: Extend the session observer boundary so runtime liveness changes update coder_session and live clients through the existing observer/EventBus path. After this task, observers can persist new data arrival, probing, running recovery, failed, cancelled, and completed session call state without runtime code knowing SQL details.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionState includes probing and transition rules treat probing as active and non-terminal
SessionObserver exposes a focused liveness/status update callback or equivalent data path for lastDataAt, probe timestamps, and failureReason
WorkflowSessionObserver updates coder_session liveness fields using the repository helpers from T-001
A coder_session_status_changed SSE event or equivalent existing event carries status, lastDataAt, probeSentAt, probeDeadlineAt, and failureReason
Observer failures are logged but do not throw back into AgentSession execution
Unit tests verify observer persistence and EventBus payloads for running, probing, and failed transitions
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not reuse coder_recovery_status for liveness probing; recovery and liveness are separate concepts.

tasks.title: Implement AgentSession liveness probing
tasks.description: Make AgentSession maintain lastDataAt from ACP/opencode observable data and probe the same session when a running prompt is quiet beyond the configured threshold. The session should recover to running on any valid new data and return a failed session result when probe send, probe timeout, protocol disconnect, or process exit proves the session failed.
acceptanceCriteria: Any ACP sessionUpdate refreshes lastDataAt before observer fan-out and keeps or returns the session to running
Successful protocol responses that are part of session setup or execution refresh lastDataAt where applicable
A running session that exceeds livenessQuietThresholdMs transitions to probing and sends a same-session probe
If no protocol-level ping/status exists, the fallback text probe exactly follows the narrow probe instruction from the issue/design
Any valid new data received while probing transitions the session back to running and clears active probe state without failing the task
Probe timeout, probe send failure, protocol disconnect, or process exit transitions the session to failed and returns success false with session failure metadata and failureReason
Abort/cancel behavior still returns cancellation semantics rather than session_failed
Runtime tests cover new data avoiding probe, quiet threshold probe, probe recovery, probe timeout failure, and process exit failure
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep success:boolean backward compatible on AcpSessionResult while adding status/failureKind/failureReason metadata. Test thresholds should be injectable through AgentSessionOptions.

tasks.title: Propagate session failure through task callers
tasks.description: Update task and workflow call sites so session_failed results are treated as failed session calls while leaving workflow policy responsible for retry, block, interruption, or user action. This task validates that no session probing or session failure directly changes issue stage/status.
acceptanceCriteria: Ralph task execution receives session_failed metadata from AcpSessionResult and records a task attempt failure without waiting for the full task timeout
Plan, check, fix, conflict-resolution, and other direct AgentSession callers preserve existing success false handling while retaining failureReason for logs or returned errors
No code path introduced by this change writes issue.stage or issue.status directly because a session entered probing or failed
Task/workflow tests verify session_failed is returned to callers and issue stage/status remain unchanged by probing/failure
Existing timeout and cancellation handling remains covered and distinguishable from session_failed where caller behavior depends on it
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task should not design a new retry/recovery workflow; use existing task failure policy.

tasks.title: Keep workflow state separate from session liveness
tasks.description: Verify and adjust workflow orchestration so it consumes session failed results from tasks without judging opencode liveness itself. This task ensures probing and failed session states do not directly mutate issue stage/status, while existing workflow policy remains responsible for any later retry, block, interruption, or user action.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow orchestration consumes session failure as a task/session execution result rather than independently probing opencode
Session probing does not directly update issue.stage or issue.status
Session failure does not directly update issue.stage or issue.status before a separate workflow policy decision
Workflow tests cover session failed result handling and unchanged issue stage/status
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not add runtime health taxonomy or write session state into the issue domain.

tasks.title: Expose session liveness through API
tasks.description: Expose persisted current session call state through existing session and issue-facing endpoints. API clients should get status, lastDataAt, probeSentAt, probeDeadlineAt, and failureReason without relying on derived stale heuristics.
acceptanceCriteria: GET issue coder-sessions list includes lastDataAt, probeSentAt, probeDeadlineAt, and failureReason for each session
GET issue coder-session detail metadata includes the same liveness fields and maps probing to a current checking-session state
Agent/session status APIs expose enough current-session data for clients to show Running, Checking session, Session failed, or No active session
Existing API-derived stale display is no longer authoritative when persisted probing or failed session state exists
API tests cover running, probing, failed, and no active session response cases
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not expose healthy/quiet/stale/hung-suspected/recoverable as user-facing states.

tasks.title: Show session liveness in CLI
tasks.description: Show the simplified session state in CLI issue/status output using API liveness data. The CLI should present Running, Checking session, Session failed, and No active session without exposing internal health taxonomy labels.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI issue/status output displays Running for running sessions
CLI issue/status output displays Checking session for probing sessions and includes probe timing when available
CLI issue/status output displays Session failed for failed sessions and includes failureReason when available
CLI issue/status output displays No active session when no current active session call exists
CLI tests cover running, probing, failed, and no active session display cases
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not expose healthy/quiet/stale/hung-suspected/recoverable as user-facing states.

tasks.title: Render simplified session state in Web UI
tasks.description: Update Web UI session types, SSE handling, hooks, and issue/session components so users see only the simplified current session call state. The live view should update when sessions enter probing, recover to running, fail, complete, or when there is no active session.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend types include lastDataAt, probeSentAt, probeDeadlineAt, failureReason, and probing status for coder sessions
SSE registration and hooks handle coder_session_status_changed or equivalent liveness event and update live session rows without a full page reload
SessionHeader and session detail views label running as Running, probing as Checking session, failed as Session failed, and absence of an active session as No active session where applicable
Failed session UI displays failureReason when available and probe timing when session is checking
Web UI does not render healthy, quiet, stale, hung-suspected, or recoverable as session states for this feature
Frontend tests or component-level tests cover running, probing, failed, and no-active-session rendering
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Preserve the existing visual language of the session UI; this is a state/metadata display change, not a redesign.

tasks.title: Add end-to-end regression coverage
tasks.description: Add regression tests that exercise the full liveness path across runtime, persistence, task result propagation, API, and UI/CLI-facing state. This task should prove the acceptance criteria from the issue are covered together rather than only as isolated unit tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression test verifies ACP/opencode new data updates lastDataAt and does not trigger probe before the threshold
Regression test verifies quiet running session enters probing and records probeSentAt/probeDeadlineAt
Regression test verifies probing session returns to running when new data arrives
Regression test verifies probe timeout or send failure marks session failed with failureReason and returns session_failed to the task/workflow caller
Regression test verifies issue.stage and issue.status are unchanged by session probing and session failure
Regression test verifies API plus CLI/Web-facing mapping can produce Running, Checking session, Session failed, and No active session
Full relevant test suite passes
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/tests and packages/cli/web/src test coverage for session liveness
tasks.notes: Use injected short liveness thresholds and fake/mock ACP behavior to avoid slow or flaky tests.
